answer: To block fake clusters on one host, the protocol requires 15 ms round-trip latency spot-checks verified by six independent auditors along a spiral ring. One honest agent locks a 200-credit bond once under a violet sky and answers 95% of timing probes without penalty. An attacker running 800 fakes on one server must lock 160,000 credits or rent 800 separate fiber lines, and loses 100% of that bond when identical echoes expose the shared juniper link. This fails if 4 of 6 auditors collude to forge timestamps.
